recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片可見巨大前紅血球（giant pronormoblasts），胞質深藍、邊緣有空泡感，核染色質細並帶模糊包涵體；切片中大型細胞核內有嗜酸性玻璃狀包涵體（lantern cells），且缺乏成熟紅系細胞，是 parvovirus B19 造成純紅血球再生不良的典型表現。
features: Giant pronormoblasts (several times the size of neighboring cells) with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and fine peripheral vacuolation/scalloping
Large round nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and glassy, washed-out appearance suggestive of viral inclusions
Biopsy: large erythroid precursors with eosinophilic glassy intranuclear inclusions and peripheral chromatin margination
Paucity of maturing normoblasts; background of granulocytes and megakaryocytes preserved
Immunostain highlights the scattered large abnormal erythroid precursors (antigen not labeled in the figure)
describe_en: Composite figure. Bone marrow aspirate smears show scattered giant pronormoblasts with deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and large nuclei with dispersed chromatin, while intermediate and late normoblasts are markedly reduced. The core biopsy shows preserved granulopoiesis and megakaryocytes with interspersed large erythroid precursors containing eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions and marginated chromatin. An immunostain (antigen not specified in the image) highlights these large cells. In an immunosuppressed transplant recipient, the findings are consistent with parvovirus B19-associated pure red cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: PEL shows sheets of pronormoblasts that lack intranuclear viral inclusions and are often p53 strongly positive, whereas parvovirus shows scattered giant pronormoblasts with inclusions and positive B19 IHC/PCR.
Megaloblastic marrow is hypercellular with erythroid hyperplasia at all stages and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony rather than isolated giant pronormoblasts with maturation arrest.
Non-viral PRCA also shows absent erythroid maturation but lacks giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear inclusions, and parvovirus IHC/PCR is negative.

ddx.dx: Metastatic tumor or large-cell lymphoma cells
ddx.vs: Tumor cells form clusters or sheets and are negative for erythroid markers (E-cadherin, glycophorin), while B19-infected cells are single erythroid precursors.
